name: Akuma no Hitokui Shokushu
source:
An adventure of a superheroine fighting against invaders from outer space!
A Japanese Sentai superheroine encounters a monster with awful tentacles. She is captured in a trap and tortured in the alien's headquarters. Once she escapes, the monster attacks her again with its tentacle and slime!!

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ002558.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
超级女英雄对抗外太空入侵者的冒险之旅！
日本战队超级女主角遇到了一个长着可怕触手的怪物。她被困在陷阱中，并在外星人的总部遭受酷刑。一旦她逃脱，怪物就会再次用触手和粘液攻击她！

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ002558.html]DLsite English[/url]]
